question: What is the correct formula of calcium hydroxide?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ca(OH)**____**2 **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical formula of Calcium Hydroxide is **Ca(OH)2**.
 
• It is also known as **Slaked lime**.
 
• It is a white powder or colorless crystal which is obtained when** Quicklime (calcium oxide) is mixed with water**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Calcium Hydroxide has many names including **hydrated lime, caustic lime, builders' lime, slack lime, pickling lime.**
 
• Ca(OH)2 has a hexagonal crystal structure.
 
• It is used in the** preparation of ammonia gas (NH3).**
 
• Slaked lime is widely used in the** food industry**, due to its low toxicity and the mildness of its basic properties.
